functions.name: GetOldPackage
functions.docs: Get the old package pointer (the original package that was replaced).

functions.name: GetNewPackage
functions.docs: Get the new package pointer (the package that replaced the original one).

functions.name: GetRepointedObjects
functions.docs: Get the raw map of repointed objects.

functions.name: GetRepointedObject
functions.signature: GetRepointedObject(Target, In Object, Out Repointed Object)
functions.docs:
Given an object pointer, check to see if it needs to be repointed to an object in the new package, and populate OutRepointedObject if needed.
@return true if the object can be repointed, false otherwise.

functions.name: RepointObject
functions.docs:
Given an object pointer, check to see if it needs to be repointed to an object in the new package, and update it if needed.
@return true if the object was repointed, false otherwise.

functions.name: GetObjectReferencers
functions.docs:
Get the set of objects that were referencing any of the objects that were replaced by the package reload.
@note Beware that object referencers may become null as the result of other operations that happen during reloading (such as recompiling Blueprints).

functions.name: AddObjectReferencer
functions.docs: Add a referencing object for any of the objects that were replaced by the package reload.

functions.name: SortPackagesForReload
functions.docs:
Given an array of packages, sort them so that dependencies will be processed before the packages that depend on them.
@param	PackagesToReload		Array of packages to sort. Will be replaced with the sorted data.

functions.name: ReloadPackage
functions.signature: ReloadPackage(In Package To Reload, In Load Flags)

functions.name: ReloadPackages
functions.signature: ReloadPackages(In Packages To Reload, Out Reloaded Packages, In Num Packages Per Batch)
